title: How can I change the actor image when they do a skill?

posts.author: PrototypeZer0_
posts.body:
It's a simple issue to solve, all games handle with properly.
The flow is:  (1) a enemy in idle pose -> (2) change the picture of skill in battle -> (3) the damage is taken -> (4) back to the idle. But I can't adjust this order.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Since you're using VisuStella, use their action sequences.

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
Yes, this isn't something you can do in a common event. This needs to be handled by the battle log, which means action sequences.
I'd also argue that, rather than hiding the enemy and showing a picture, it'd make more sense to just change the enemy's image. Not 100% sure how to do that, but it should be possible. (If you're lucky, maybe VisuStella action sequences has that as a built-in option.)
